title: GenomicsChain Tier-3 executed-R Verdict Record
description: Metadata-only record for a Tier-3 execution verdict. Raw genomic inputs/outputs stay local; only hashes + verdict identity + attestation binding are recorded. record_version 0.3 SPLITS the single `verdict` enum into two independent axes (execution_verdict, comparison_verdict), because 'did it run' and 'did it match' are separate questions and the corpus survey (2026-08-14, n=5 papers passing the Tier-1 gate) found 0/5 papers declaring any comparison target. Under 0.2 a completed run with nothing to compare against was forced into `executed_inconclusive_needs_tolerance`, naming a complete result as an incomplete one. No 0.2 records were ever issued, so 0.3 replaces rather than extends it.

record_version.description: Schema version. 0.3 = two-axis verdict. Pre-1.0; bump freely on field changes.

jobspec_digest.description: sha256 of the canonical JobSpec (env lock + data pins + pipeline). The server RECOMPUTES it from the submitted jobspec_json and validates it against the accepted Stage-2 subject. When run_count > 1 this identifies the ONE spec that was repeated, not one digest per run.

execution_verdict.description: AXIS 1 — did the job run? completed = terminated successfully with a non-empty output set. env_failed = the environment or the command failed. data_blocked = the declared inputs could not be obtained. outputs_unusable = it terminated but produced nothing usable. This axis says NOTHING about whether the result matches anything.

comparison_verdict.description: AXIS 2 — did the result match a declared target? no_target_declared = the paper publishes no checksum or nominated artifact, so there was nothing to compare against (the COMMON case: 0/5 in the 2026-08-14 survey). match_exact = byte-identical to the declared target. match_normalized = identical after the comparator's declared normalisation (e.g. archive containers unpacked, mtimes ignored). mismatch = a target existed and the result differed. not_attempted = execution did not reach the comparison step.

environment_provenance.description: WHOSE environment ran. declared_container = a container image digest the paper declared. declared_lock = an environment file (conda YAML etc.) the paper declared. declared_tools = a tool+version list the paper declared, resolved by the runner. authored_by_operator = the operator built an environment the paper did not supply — a certificate MUST NOT present this as 'the declared environment'. none = no environment was pinned. Not a quality score: it records who is accountable for the environment.

inputs_provenance.description: WHERE the inputs came from. public_accession = a public repository accession (ENA/GEO/SRA). archive_doi = a deposited archive (Zenodo etc.). controlled_access = an application-gated source (UK Biobank, dbGaP) — a third party cannot repeat the run. operator_supplied = the operator provided inputs the paper did not publish. unknown = not determined.

run_count.description: How many independent executions of the same JobSpec were performed. 1 establishes only that it ran. >=2 additionally establishes whether repeated execution yields the same result — see self_consistency. Cost scales linearly with this number, so it is the operator's choice, not a fixed policy.

self_consistency.description: Present only when run_count >= 2. Reports whether the repeated runs agreed. A certificate states the NUMBER OF RUNS, never the words 'stable' or 'deterministic': the reader decides what N runs are worth.

all_identical.description: True when every run produced the same result under comparator_id.

comparator_id.description: Comparator used for the run-to-run comparison. Note this may differ from the paper-target comparator.

first_divergence.description: First observed difference between runs, when all_identical is false.

variation.description: Whether the repeats varied the environment. same_environment detects pipeline-internal nondeterminism only; distinct_environments additionally detects environment dependence.

trust_tier.description: Enforceable guarantee tier. MVP: server enforces self_reported = a non-repudiable signed assertion of a CLAIMED run; execution NOT independently verified.

result_hash.description: sha256 over the sorted canonical list [{relative_path, sha256, size_bytes}] of fetched outputs, RECOMPUTED locally by the runner. Not the backend-reported hash. When run_count >= 2 this is the first run's hash; the rest are in self_consistency.run_result_hashes.

backend_result_hash.description: Optional backend-reported result hash. Divergence from result_hash -> execution_verdict env_failed (transport/backend tamper).

expected_output.description: OPTIONAL. Absent when comparison_verdict is no_target_declared, which is the common case. Present only when a comparison target exists.

target.description: "file:<relative_path>" for a single output file, otherwise the aggregate result tree.

source.description: Provenance of the comparison target. Only paper_declared with a resolvable citation backs a leaderboard verdict.

source_citation.description: DOI / supplementary-table / figure reference the hosted side can spot-check.

expected_output_sha256.description: OPTIONAL top-level copy of expected_output.sha256, part of the signed identity when a target exists.

comparator_id.description: Comparator used against the declared target. Absent when no target was declared.

backend_id.description: Execution backend that produced the result.

container_digest.description: Digest of the container image that ran, when environment_provenance is declared_container. Recorded at execution time: registry tags move (measured 2026-08-17 — a December-2025 preprint's image had been re-pushed that morning), so the tag alone does not identify the run.

result_evidence_sha256.description: sha256 of the Tier-3 result bundle (backend outputs, jobspec digest, output file list).

leaderboard_eligible.description: Server-set eligibility CLAIM. Requires execution_verdict=completed AND comparison_verdict in {match_exact, match_normalized} AND expected_output.source=paper_declared with a signed source_citation. DELIBERATELY LEFT UNREACHABLE for papers that declare no target: the strong claim is not loosened to make the leaderboard non-empty. Under trust_tier=self_reported it remains a signed self-claim, not a verified fact.

elapsed_seconds.description: Total across all runs when run_count >= 2.

backend_metadata.description: Optional backend-specific fields (thoa_job_id, etc.). Not signed.

operator.description: Operator identity envelope. Leaderboard-contributing verdicts require signed mode; anonymous is excluded from consensus.
